meta.title: Remote Access
meta.description: Single-admin LAN access, pairing QR, artifact downloads, and remote file uploads for the DSH desktop Web GUI.

plugin.title: Remote access
plugin.desc: Open this DSH desktop from a phone or tablet on the same LAN. Sign in once with the administrator password, then use the normal DSH interface.
plugin.pickerTruncated: Too many folders; showing the first 1000.
plugin.security: Security: the administrator password protects this DSH on the LAN. Use a strong password and never share it.
plugin.localNoLogout: This is the local desktop window. Remote sign-out is only available from the LAN page.
plugin.proxyDown: No listener on the LAN port
plugin.noLan: No private IPv4 address detected. Connect this PC to the LAN and restart DSH.
plugin.error: Could not load remote access status
plugin.defaultPassword: The default password admin / dsh-remote is in use. Run scripts/set-remote-password.ps1 to change it.
plugin.mobileNoSession: Open or create a session first
plugin.mobileDrawerHint: Tap a session to open it
plugin.mobileToggleBlocked: Close the remote plugin from the desktop window. Disabling it here would drop this connection.
plugin.proxyToggleBlocked: This page is served through the remote proxy. Disabling the plugin would drop this page; open the DSH direct window instead.
plugin.accountRemoteOnly: Sign in or out of the DeepSeek account on the computer; refresh this page afterwards.
plugin.toggleUsePanel: Use Pause/Resume in the Remote Access panel. The plugin-manager master switch restarts DSH.
